newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares close down, seen rangebound.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares close down, seen rangebound.

text.p: 1230 GMT - Austrian shares close lower, suffering from continuing disappointment over the index's failure to break through resistance at 1,100 points, traders say. ATX seen in range of 1,070 to 1,090.
* ATX index down 6.23 points or 0.58 percent at 1,075.25
* November ATX future down 4.0 points at 1,076.5
* Leading gainer airport group Flughafen, up 2.6 schillings at 536.6
* Leading decliner luxury hosiery maker Wolford, down 45 schillings at 1,425
* Vienna Bourse index down 2.07 points or 0.5 percent at 412.72
